logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Single-panel vertical bar chart for the WO-02 round-2 verification memo. X-axis: candidates P1, P2, P3, P4 left to right. Y-axis: measured energy in kWh on the shared HVAC duty test, scale 0-55 with gridlines every 10. Bars drawn to true trusted-table values: P1 50, P2 33, P3 20, P4 9; the P4 bar accented as the client-selected lowest-energy qualifier. Print each bar's energy value above it (50, 33, 20, 9). Beneath each candidate label print quality index and raw defects: P1 QI 92 defects 3; P2 QI 82 defects 1; P3 QI 98 defects 2; P4 QI 100 defects 5. Draw short bracket annotations between adjacent bar tops labeling successive energy gaps: P1-P2 17 kWh, P2-P3 13, P3-P4 11. Add one note line stating all four candidates qualify (quality at least 80, defects at most 5) and that P4's five defects sit exactly at the ceiling, correcting the proposal's zero-defect claim. Clean white background, sans-serif labels, no decorative elements.
